steps.text: Free Valve title, Source 2, D3D11, steam appid 1902490. Needs a game controller for actual play (menu works with keyboard).

knownIssues.symptom: Black screen with DXMT 0.80 (frames present at ~48 fps but nothing rendered; -sw windowed does not help)
knownIssues.cause: DXMT + Source 2 presentation issue on this engine
knownIssues.fix: use dxvk (correct) or d3dmetal (fast but corrupted)

knownIssues.symptom: Severe block-pattern texture corruption with D3DMetal 3.0 (menu and world visible, ~38-44 fps)
knownIssues.cause: unknown; D3DMetal + Source 2 on Wine 10 Sikarugir engine

lastVerified.result: dxvk: correct rendering, ~31 fps at 1728x1117 (GPU 13 ms, CPU 32 ms). d3dmetal: 38-44 fps, heavy texture corruption. dxmt 0.80: black screen. wined3d: untested.
